capture_schedule: Run immediately, then 3600 seconds after each invocation finishes.

coverage.open_interest: 20 sorted active USDT perpetual symbols per cycle with a rotating offset; raw status responses preserve the full contemporaneous symbol list

timestamp_semantics.source_event_timestamps_utc_ms: source-provided observed event or response timestamps only
timestamp_semantics.source_scheduled_timestamps_utc_ms: future schedule fields such as nextFundingTime only
timestamp_semantics.local_arrival_utc: local UTC arrival recorded after each response

foreground_probe.reason_for_bounded_background_shards: A full sequential OI sweep was too slow through the current network path; the successful records were preserved and the background cycle was bounded instead of increasing infrastructure complexity.

research_tier_effect: Prospective raw evidence only. It does not upgrade historical Price V1 or any prior Tier classification.
